amendment_history.reason: Correction of CRLF/LF SHA inconsistency for HorizonGoldbach.lean. The original manifest at be8b6e6 captured a CRLF-version SHA (1b7d6847..., 15584 B) for HorizonGoldbach.lean because Phase 3.1's Get-FileHash invocation on Windows read the working-tree CRLF form, while HorizonCertified.lean happened to be measured at its canonical LF form (3bf0cdfe..., 6984 B). The index itself has always stored canonical LF for both files. This amendment realigns the recorded artifact SHAs with the canonical LF versions, enforced going forward by the .gitattributes file added in commit 221a3db. The original manifest remains accessible at tag g26-v5-watchlist-closed (commit cd65569). manifest_version bumped 1.0 -> 1.1.
